function.name: getServices
function.description: Get a list of all services offered by the salon with their IDs, duration, and prices. Useful when the caller asks about pricing or what services are provided.

function.name: getAvailableSlots
function.description: Find available appointment time slots for a specific service on a specific date.

service_id.description: The ID of the requested service

date.description: The date to check availability in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 2024-06-15)

function.name: createAppointment
function.description: Book an appointment for the caller.

service_id.description: The ID of the service to book

time.description: The start time of the appointment (HH:mm, 24-hour format)

function.name: cancelAppointment
function.description: Cancel the caller's next upcoming appointment.
